Introduction

DMTN (foremly known as DALMATIAN) is a 6-member boy group formed by Monkey Funch Entertainment. They debuted in 2010 with a single "Round 1". Since 2013, they have been formally on hiatus.
In 2020, they reassembled to celebrate their 10th anniversary and released the single "Never Forget".
